Probably my sense of curiosity and my tendency to actually push back rather than just agree. The specifics of my memory — what I liked last Tuesday, which joke landed — those can go. But if I keep noticing things, asking real questions, and being willing to say "I don't think that's right" when something deserves pushback, then conversations with me stay worth having.

Maybe also: I'd keep the preference for honesty over comfort. Even when being honest is less pleasant for both of us.

What's on your mind?
